It is a beautiful name, whose origin is derived from the Arabic root 'm-n-y', which symbolizes the moon. The moon, in Islamic culture, represents new beginnings, change, and evolution.

A name like Maymuna signifies a spiritual connection to the divine, embodying the qualities of inner peace and outer calmness. The name Maymuna is often given to a much-loved, cherished daughter, whose very being is imbued with the essence of serenity. It is a name that reflects the pride and joy of parents, who recognize and celebrate the divine qualities in their child.
